# TierOne

> Free, hands-on IT training platform. Four tracks — Help Desk, SysAdmin, CompTIA A+, and Scripting (PowerShell + Python) — with lessons, quizzes, in-browser labs, spaced-repetition review, and practice exams.

## Tracks
- Help Desk (Tier 1 & 2): IT support fundamentals, ticketing, Windows/AD/M365, troubleshooting.
- SysAdmin: Windows Server, Active Directory, networking, automation.
- CompTIA A+: hardware, operating systems, networking, security, troubleshooting.
- Scripting: PowerShell and Python for IT automation.

## Features
- In-browser terminal labs, virtual help desk ticket simulations, spaced review, timed practice exams, progress tracking and certificates.
